learnings: Created Favorites.razor at @page '/Favorites' that injects FavoritesProvider, loads favorites in OnInitializedAsync, shows a 'No favorites yet' message when empty, and renders the same Grid<DeckInfo> column layout as MoxfieldScraping.razor with an OnUnfavorited callback that removes the deck from _deckList immediately.
Added a Favorites NavMenuLink (fa-solid fa-heart icon, Href='Favorites') to NavMenu.razor between the Settings link and the Start Chrome button.
